messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: Elevated egress queueing detected in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Error spike: 5xx (502/504) and delayed streaming. Affected pools: gpu-pool-eu-west-1a, gpu-pool-us-east-1b. Sample log:
```
router: conn_write_timeout: 120s, rtt=350ms, queued=420
tcp: RST surge from bgp-peer-12
```
Please acknowledge.

mia: Ack — joining bridge now. creating mitigation plan: shift traffic by weight away from eu-west toward eu-central and enable burst nodes.

aj: rolling routing weight change (will be quick): set route-policy egress-weight eu-central +20%, eu-west -30%. watching queue depth and backpressure.

leo: initiating temporary per-customer ingress caps for top 5 heavy hitters. enabling KV cache warmup on eu-central to reduce cold KVs.

sara: dashboards: https://internal.metrics/redwood/egress-queueing — alerts firing for queue_depth > 250. adding short-window alert for 5xx rate.

emily: Support standing by — which customers are impacted right now? need a short blurb for live chats and CS reps.

patrick: Draft status page blurb for review:
"Investigating elevated egress queueing impacting request latency and occasional 5xx errors in EU and US regions. We're shifting traffic to alternate regions and applying temporary rate limits. ETA for mitigation: ~45-60 minutes. Next update in 30 minutes. Status: Investigating — Engineers actively working."

mia: Traffic shift applied at +3m. queue depth eu-west dropped from ~420 -> ~190. still seeing intermittent 502s for a few customers.

aj: root hint: egress-polisher v2 holding sockets under TCP RST bursts from a peer AS; causing extreme socket hold times. rolling back egress-polisher v2 -> v1 across affected pools now.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: rollback egress-polisher v2 -> v1 started (build/2025) by aj.

leo: Post-rollback telemetry: 5xx rate down ~72% in eu-west. queue depths trending downward. keeping caches warming for eu-central traffic.

emily: Thanks — preparing customer-facing Slack/Email template and live chat snippets. will attach and push to shared drive.

patrick: Published status update and incident ticker: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2035012300 — included mitigation steps and ETA.

mia: Leaving bridge open for 2 hours for observation; will close if no regression. keeping thread pinned for any customer escalations.
